How to play Filmcode

Can you guess a movie from its colors alone? Filmcode is a free movie color palette quiz.

  1. Look at the complete color barcode, from left to right.
  2. Consider the colors, lighting and transitions. Think about the films you have seen.
  3. Choose one of the four movie titles. You get one guess per challenge in your browser.
  4. Discover the answer and share your result without revealing the movie.

Do I need an account?

No. Your current pilot attempt and theme preference are stored in your browser.

Can I change the appearance?

Yes. Use the light or dark mode switch on the game page. The barcode stays the same in both themes.
